title: Technician II Fertigation and Root-Zone Verification Log
description: A traceable record for approved fertigation execution, source-water and batch measurements, irrigation delivery, runoff or drainage, root-zone trends, and escalation decisions.
instructions: Record the effective recipe or work-instruction identifier and material identities before mixing.
Keep source-water, final-batch, delivered irrigation, drainage, and root-zone measurements as separate fields.
Use repeated trends and matched crop context rather than a single EC or pH value to assign a cause.
Document any hold, deviation, or escalation when identity, calculation, measurement quality, chemistry, or delivery is uncertain.
limitations: This template does not provide a universal nutrient recipe, pH target, EC target, dryback target, or irrigation schedule.
Chemical handling, concentrate mixing, sanitation, and equipment work remain subject to the approved site procedure and safety controls.
publicationNote: Owner-approved academic learner support. Not a regulated record, facility SOP, assessor score sheet, or professional credential issuance instrument.
